Represents shares of Common Stock withheld by UniFirst Corporation to satisfy certain tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of certain restricted stock units.

Represents restricted stock units granted under the UniFirst Corporation 2023 Stock Option and Incentive Plan (the "2023 Plan"). Such restricted stock units vest in three equal annual installments on November 2, 2027, November 2, 2028 and November 2, 2029. || These are annual grants for fiscal 2027. || Consists of (i) 6,226 shares of Common Stock owned by the reporting person, (ii) 394 restricted stock units that vest in one remaining annual installment on October 31, 2027, (iii) 913 restricted stock units that vest in two equal annual installments on October 31, 2027 and October 31, 2028, (iii) 736 restricted stock units that vest in one remaining annual installment on October 31, 2027, (iv) 1,627 restricted stock units that vest in two equal installments on October 31, 2027 and October 31, 2028, and (v) 3,289 restricted stock units that vest in three equal annual installments on November 2, 2027, November 2, 2028 and November 2, 2029.
